notes.title: Bees Knees now on sale.
notes.content:
Hi All,

Our fun little bug blaster is currently on sale, so if this has been on your wishlist (And if you love retro, it should be), now is your chance to grab a bargin.

Enjoy,

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Bees Knees is now live
notes.content:
Hello all 

Our second old-school inspired game, Bees Knees, is now live, as we continue our mission to bring our take on retro styled gaming to you.

"Take control of the state of the art, Robotically Assisted Pneumatic Horticultural All Environment Levitator (Often simply called R.A.P.H.A.E.L), the latest weapon deployed by the honey industry in the war on bugs. "

If you love the feel of retro game play as much as we do, and miss the old games of the 1980's and early 90's, we're sure you'll love Bees Knees.

The JimJamsGames team.
